turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, and my son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class. Start with who decided that, and when.
Can I ask your advice as a mom?
You're asking me how to do your job? I'm here as Owen's mother, and what I want is the zero withdrawn. Who decided to enter it, and why did nobody call me first?
My nephew lives with me and lies about homework constantly. How do you get through to a kid like that?
That's between you and your family, Hale. If you're comparing my son to him, I'm writing that down. You still haven't told me who decided to enter the zero.
